rows.quote: This research provides comprehensive summary statistics on the genetic associations of 4907 circulating protein levels (Ferkingstad et al. 2021).The summary GWAS data for VaD were obtained from the 10th release of the FinnGen consortium (https://r8.risteys.finngen.fi/).
